products.title: Products
products.pageStatus: Page {page, number, integer} of {pageCount, number, integer}

productForm.title: Title
productForm.seoHint: Leave empty to use the title and short description.
productForm.fallbackHint: Empty fields fall back to the other language on the store.
productForm.slugHint: Leave empty to generate it from the title. Changing it breaks old links.
productForm.fixedPriceSarHint: Optional. Overrides the price converted at the store's exchange rate.
productForm.compareAtPriceHint: Optional. Shown struck through; must be higher than the price.
productForm.createdNotice: Product created. Add images and files, then publish it.

media.title: Images
media.accepted: PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF, up to {size}, at least 100 × 100 pixels.

files.title: Files
files.hint: Buyers always download the newest version of each file.
files.empty: No files yet. Add at least one before publishing.
files.accepted: PDF, ZIP, EPUB, Office documents, audio, video, images and fonts, up to {size}.
files.removeDescription: Files that have been downloaded are kept in the history; others are deleted.

upload.failed: The upload failed. Please try again.

lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.publishHint: Publishing needs at least one file.
lifecycle.archiveHint: Archived products leave the store; buyers keep their downloads.
lifecycle.deleteDescription: The product, its images and its files are deleted permanently.
lifecycle.archiveDescription: It disappears from the store. Buyers keep access to what they bought.

preview.banner: Preview: this is how the product page looks to customers.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories appear in this order on the store.
categories.slugHint: Leave empty to generate it from the name.
categories.deleteDescription: Only empty categories can be deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rateHint: SAR prices are converted with this rate and rounded half up to the halala. Past orders keep the rate they were placed at.
